# HALF 2 – Exploration and replication {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Second half – about 75 minutes
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. In the first half you reproduced a published number, which everyone could do because everyone ran the same code. Now you become the sixth analyst and make choices of your own. We open the menu of decisions that any analysis of this claim has to take, you try a few in the browser lab, and we place what you tried among every justifiable specification on these data. Then we leave the original data behind and look at the new audit that tested the claim again.
:::
